summary.text: Dan Horoshak is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 7B, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a laborer and union member from the fifth generation of his family in the Iron Range area.

paragraphs.text: Dan Horoshak said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include financial support for schools and teachers, adding a single-payer buy-in option to MNsure, and safe patient-to-nurse staffing ratios.

He also listed support for small businesses, infrastructure and job growth in rural Minnesota and the Iron Range, and named education, health care, and unions and labor rights as areas of policy interest.
